requirement_results.observed_evidence: The current roadmap, Stage 1 and registered claim all retain the bounded evidence-audit purpose and explicitly reject universal model superiority.

Stages 1-7 have objectives and dispositions, but current stage documents contain unresolved paths to moved docs/reports files, a superseded Stage 5 filename and a nonexistent src/mlcra/stage05 directory; the complete current trace is therefore not path-valid.

CLI, dashboard, bilingual documentation and public repository remain expected in Stage 1, but no John-approved required/optional/deferred/out-of-scope disposition and acceptance consequence exists for the current project boundary.
The bounded claim resolves through registered protocols/configuration, canonical Stage 5 evidence and the accepted strongly_supported verdict; all named mandatory paths exist.
The unweakened cumulative pilot validated registered seeds, split geometry, metric semantics, schemas, verdict policy, golden relations and all 18 protected hashes.

The current Stage 5 and Stage 6 formulations bind the result to MiniBooNE and the registered protocols, prohibit universal superiority, disclose partial parameter instability and the 55.195823 fit-time ratio.

Stage 7 closure re-audit reports seven of seven criteria PASS; the cumulative AST/API gates confirm 10 modules, 89 public contracts and no top-level Stage 5 implementation in the 12 orchestration cells.

Baseline, Python syntax, 145 CSV structures, four nonempty notebooks, deterministic fixtures, negative mutations, historical regressions and the full cumulative pilot all returned PASS without a weakened rule.

Stage 6 labels the project as a documented evidence package rather than a stable software product; Stage 7 exposes modular contracts, but no John-approved supported external interface or research-only interface inventory is designated.
No pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, environment.yml or lock file exists. Environment CSV observations do not form an installable specification, so clean reconstruction cannot be performed.

No root README or declared clean-environment setup exists. Stage 6 documents evidence reading and historical reproduction, but it does not provide a self-contained fresh-copy command with declared dependencies for the supported project path.

Checkpoint v52 is exact at 1149362 bytes and SHA-256 56e51b..., has 275 unique entries and 273 files, no duplicates or forbidden local artifacts, and matches the 273-file workspace; runtime and promotion provenance gates also pass.
README.md and README.rst are absent from the project root; roadmap.md is a governance record, not a root entry document containing the complete required onboarding content.

Installation and fresh-environment reproduction instructions are absent, so the full instruction walkthrough cannot be executed. The existing venv passes pip check, but that does not prove reconstructability.

Nine unique current documentation references do not resolve: historical docs/reports paths were not rewritten to docs/archive/reports, two stage documents name the superseded stage_05_methodological_stress_testing.md, and Stage 6 names nonexistent src/mlcra/stage05/.

No standardized packaging metadata exists and current Stage 6 only limits the present state to a documented evidence package; John has not decided whether Python distribution is a current target or approved a durable non-distribution release class.
No dist directory or claimed installable artifact exists, but this conditional requirement cannot be SKIPPED until John approves a non-distributed release class.
Checkpoint v52 passes uniqueness and denylist checks, but a release inventory cannot be declared complete until the intended release class and its required contents are approved.
No LICENSE variant or explicit John-approved non-open redistribution policy exists. Selecting a license or non-open policy is reserved for John.

Local OpenML records label dataset 41150 as CC0 and leave citation_required TO_VERIFY, while the current authoritative UCI record identifies CC BY 4.0 and DOI 10.24432/C5QC87. Included derived evidence therefore lacks a reconciled source/terms/citation and redistribution disposition.
CITATION.cff is absent and no John-approved alternative identifies creators, preferred citation and release identifier; those identity fields cannot be inferred by the agent.

Local credential-pattern scan found zero matches and pip check found no broken installed requirements, but there is no dependency specification or security policy and pip-audit is unavailable; release dependency risk cannot be bounded.
All non-PASS audit results are registered in nine findings with owner and consequence, but John-owned scope, release, legal and acceptance dispositions remain pending.
Fail-closed recomputation yields project_completion_verdict FAIL and external_release_readiness FAIL; John acceptance and any proceed/release decision remain pending and cannot be inferred.
